decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter builds directly on the firm's core curing and slicing know-how, fits its stated organic expansion strategy as a flagship line, and the firm can readily interpret retail feedback and refine it.

Organic poultry mini salami is a smaller step from the firm's pork-based curing expertise, but it fits the organic and snack direction and has its own website page, so management will likely keep learning from it for another year.

The premium sharing salami snack draws on established salami maturation and seasoning capabilities, has its own page and several variants, and offers a new format the firm can assess and adjust with existing knowledge.
